feeds.title: Agriland Farming News » Sheep
feeds.description: Agriland Farming brings you the fastest Sheep farming news and updates for Irish sheep farmers. Read articles detailing the Sheep and Beef industries and other developments the Agribusiness sector. Agriland.ie is a digital publisher that aims to bring together in one online resource all the information, news and services required by people involved in the agricultural and farming sectors.

feeds.title: Texel Sheep Society News
feeds.description: Here you will find Information and resources from The British Texel Sheep Society including regularly updated Texel News, Shows, and Sale Information. The British Texel Sheep Society maintains the largest registry of pedigree Texel sheep. The society consistently markets breeding rams through its regional clubs in the UK.

feeds.title: Southdown Sheep Society News
feeds.description: News articles and updates from the Southdown Sheep Society. Learn all about the Southdown breed and other livestock. The Southdown Sheep Society represents the interests of Southdown breeders in the UK and provides registration and marketing services to breeders across the country.

feeds.title: The Scottish Farmer » Sheep
feeds.description: Explore in-depth analysis and news articles covering Sheep auctions and sale events all over the UK in The Scottish Farmer's Sheep Section. Our magazine supports local farming by providing essential farming views and business data to aid farmers. Other features include politics and agricultural personalities.

feeds.title: Suffolk Sheep Society Blog
feeds.description: Suffolk Sheep Society's blog distributes pertinent information and the latest developments concerning the Suffolk breed of Sheep. The Society was established with the key aims of protecting the integrity of the breed, supporting our members, and promoting Suffolks as the leading domestic terminal sire.

feeds.title: Agriland Farming News » Sheep
feeds.description: Gather all the latest Sheep farming news and sheep updates for UK sheep farmers from Agriland Farming. Agriland is one of the fastest-growing digital Agricultural news publishers in Europe. We deliver current and breaking farming news, views, opinions, and technical information to farmers and the agricultural business community.

feeds.title: Graze » Sheep
feeds.description: Read our informative, analytical articles concerning the latest news from sheep Farming and Industry. Graze magazine is devoted to management-intensive rotational grazing and family-scale livestock farms. Our website is packed with ideas from real grazing farmers and ranchers who make their livings from the land.

feeds.title: Sheep Central News
feeds.description: SheepCentral.com is a free online news and market intelligence service dedicated to the Australian sheep and wool industries. Every day, Sheepcentral.com is updated with business-focused content written specifically for the sheep and wool industries, including industry news, market and price trends, and supply and demand updates.

feeds.title: All Saints Valais Blacknose Sheep Blog
feeds.description: Our weekly blog, 'Holy Sheep!' follows our journey with ruminations on faith, our flock, and following the Good Shepherd.Not only are we a couple of new shepherds who are slightly in over our heads when it comes to raising sheep and bringing 'the cutest sheep in the world' across the continents to Middle Tennessee - but we're also dedicating this wild and woolly adventure of ours to the Lord as our 'breed-up' program begins with a flock of four pregnant 'F2' lambs.

feeds.title: Meridian Jacobs Blog » Sheep
feeds.description: Robin Lynde shares her stories from Life On the Farm and At the Loom along with other insights about sheep raising. Learn about raising sheep and marketing fiber while having fun at Meridian Jacob's blog. Meridian Jacobs farm and shop is a local source for supplies, classes, and locally grown fiber and yarn.

feeds.title: Raising Sheep Blog
feeds.description: In this blog you'll find hundreds of articles about sheep, sheep breeds, raising sheep for fun, show, and profit, and much more. Raising Sheep is a website by Joe with the goal of creating a comprehensive resource about sheep and sheep farming. Joe is a Sheep Farmer and likes to share here his knowledge, tips, and tricks he's learned over the years.

feeds.title: Crossroads Land & Livestock Blog
feeds.description: Crossroads Land & Livestock in their educational blog talk about the various aspects involved in sheep production. Read articles that help you in managing an bettering your sheep farm life. At Crossroads, we work to create a system that is productive, profitable, and less work, giving you more time to do what really matters.

feeds.title: Living with Gotlands Blog
feeds.description: In the Living with Gotlands blog, Kim Goodling shares her life at Vermont Grand View Farm with Sweden curly sheep and two busy border collies named Kai and Tuf. Settle in with a cup of tea, and learn about wool crafts, homesteading, and raising sheep, as well as Gotland Sheep, Homesteading, and other fun farm activities.

feeds.title: SheepMetrix Blog
feeds.description: Our blog updates you on the Industry and what we have been up to here at Sheep Metrix. Keep checking for consistent posts on Sheep, Rearing DNA testing, and a range of topics encompassing Livestock. SheepMetriX is an independent consultancy business working as a team with ram and commercial sheep breeders to improve productivity and profitability with quality information and advice.

feeds.title: Maternal Sheep Group Blog
feeds.description: Our group's blog offers excellent reading material to sheep farmers on how we work among other processes. The Maternal Sheep Group (MSG) is a representative of over Five Thousand performance recorded ewes over 10 farms across Scotland, Northern Ireland, and England. Our aim is to provide sheep requiring less labor to increase profitability.

feeds.title: Sheep Producers Association of Nova Scotia » Sheep News
feeds.description: Get the latest Industry News, Important information & Events Archives from the Sheep Producers Association of Nova Scotia. SPAN exists to promote and assist in the sustainable development of Nova Scotia's sheep industry in the best interest of the members and ultimately all Nova Scotians.

feeds.title: Solace Farmer Blog
feeds.description: Solace Farmer Blog is a great resource of general information, tips, and recipes for Shepherds and Goat herders. The Solace Farm produces Fiber for spinning, felting, and weaving. We also sell handspun yarns and do custom spinning for your projects as well as create artisan-made items from our hands to your home.
